Haimavatī
(‘daughter of Himavān’)
------------------------------------------
Pārvatī, the consort of Lord शिव, is known by several names, one of which is हैमवती, since she was born as the daughter of Himavān, the king of the हिमालयस्.
The Kenopaniṣad (3.12; 4.1) declares that Umā हैमवती appeared before the crestfallen इन्द्र and taught to him ब्रह्मविद्या or knowledge of ब्रह्मन्.
